items.title: 8.3 Macroscopic aur microscopic waqiat ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3, printed page 170, with Quick Check 8.1 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Macroscopic events bohat se microscopic events ka nateeja hain jo ek hi waqt ho rahe hote hain. Microscopic events samajh kar hum equilibrium system mein nazar aane wali macroscopic tabdeeliyon ko samjha bhi sakte hain aur in ka pehle se andaza (prediction) bhi laga sakte hain.

Jab kisi chemical reaction ka equilibrium badalta hai to is ko samjhane wale microscopic events particles ya molecules ki collisions aur naye bonds ka banna hain. Yeh collisions forward aur reverse reactions ki rates badalti hain, aur yeh rates activation energy aur bahar ke factors (jaise temperature, pressure) se mutasir hoti hain. Yeh sab microscopic events mil kar macroscopic tabdeeliyon ki shakal mein nazar aate hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Macroscopic aur microscopic events mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic events nangi aankh se nazar aate hain, jaise rang badalna, gas nikalna ya pressure badalna. Microscopic events nazar nahi aate, jaise molecules ki collisions, bonds ka tootna aur banna, electrons ka lena dena. Macroscopic tabdeeli bohat se microscopic events ka majmooa hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Equilibrium dynamic hai. Microscopic events ke zariye wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium par koi tabdeeli nazar nahi aati, lekin reactant molecules ab bhi takra kar bonds tor rahe aur products bana rahe hain, aur product molecules bhi takra kar wapas reactants bana rahe hain. Dono amal bilkul barabar rate se chalte hain, is liye mixture ki composition constant rehti hai jabke molecules ki harkat kabhi nahi rukti.

blocks.prompt: c) H₂O(g) + CO(g) ⇌ H₂(g) + CO₂(g) mein equilibrium par products ki concentration zyada hai. (i) Concentration aur time ka graph, (ii) rate aur time ka graph kaisa hoga?
blocks.explanation: (i) H₂O aur CO ke curves oopar se shuru ho kar girte hain, H₂ aur CO₂ ke curves zero se barhte hain; equilibrium ke baad sab curves seedhe (flat) ho jate hain aur products ke curves reactants se oopar rehte hain. (ii) Forward rate sab se oopar se shuru ho kar girti hai, reverse rate zero se barhti hai; dono mil kar ek seedhi lakeer ban jati hain (topic 8.2 ka hamara rate graph dekhein).

items: Macroscopic tabdeeliyan bohat se microscopic events ka majmooa hain.
Equilibrium ki tabdeeli collisions aur naye bonds se samjhai jati hai, jo forward aur reverse rates badalti hain.
